extension.description: Reviews destructive Artisan database wipes, migration resets, and queue purges.
extension.name: Laravel command protection

permissions.description: Identifies Artisan db:wipe operations that drop all database tables, views, and types.
permissions.label: Laravel database wipe
safer_guidance: Inspect migrations with migrate:status and confirm a current backup before wiping the database.

permissions.description: Identifies Artisan migrate:fresh operations that drop every table and re-run all migrations.
permissions.label: Laravel destructive rebuild
safer_guidance: Run migrate:status and review pending migrations before rebuilding the database from scratch.

permissions.description: Identifies Artisan migrate:reset and migrate:refresh operations that roll back every migration.
permissions.label: Laravel migration reset
safer_guidance: Review the rollback SQL with migrate:reset --pretend before resetting every migration.

permissions.description: Identifies Artisan migrate:rollback operations that revert the last migration batch.
permissions.label: Laravel migration rollback
safer_guidance: Inspect pending batches with migrate:status and dump the rollback SQL with --pretend first.

permissions.description: Identifies Artisan queue:clear and queue:flush operations that delete queued or failed jobs.
permissions.label: Laravel queue purge
safer_guidance: Inspect queued and failed jobs before clearing or flushing queue state.
